<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1218
Claimant:
Leslie Sanchez
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
3-13-23
Claim opened after the insured's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The claimant reports a neck strain
and says the other vehicle drifted into the lane as they moved over.
3-20-23
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and coverage was in force at the time of
loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
4-19-23
Spoke with the claimant, who described the collision the same way as in the first report. The account has stayed
consistent across every conversation so far.
7-2-23
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene. Independent witnesses describe the
sideswipe as it was reported to us.
7-11-23
Photos from the scene and the other driver's statement both match the described impact. Damage to the vehicle is
mostly consistent with a side-to-side contact of this kind.
8-19-23
Checked prior claims and records for the vehicle and found no earlier damage on file. The claimant has also reported
no earlier problems with the neck or upper back.
8-26-23
The reported neck strain is a plausible injury for a lateral impact of this type. Treatment has continued somewhat
longer than is typical for this injury, so the file will be reviewed at the next interval.
9-3-23
Medical records and treatment notes are being gathered to support the injury timeline. Claim remains open pending
the final medical update and repair estimate review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
